readme: Generated by `pnpm seed --sync` / `--publish` — never hand-edited. One entry per card published since #75, holding the picked bake-off candidate's sidecar: `model` is what the response NAMED (null when the provider names nothing, e.g. cloudflare-sdxl), `params` is what was ASKED FOR, and `reviewKey` content-addresses the bytes by prompt+ART_STYLE hash and parameter hash. `reviewed: false` means the bytes were generated at publish time under --allow-unreviewed and no human ever saw them. Cards published before #75 are absent and stay absent: their review files are gone and inventing entries would be fabrication. See src/features/pool/provenance.ts.
